title: The Stolen Map
scene: At 11:40 AM, the antique map left its case during a fire drill. The museum's west wing stayed locked until noon.

suspects.name: Hana Sato
suspects.testimony: I was leading the evacuation in the east hall from 11:35 to 11:55.
suspects.alibiProof: The east hall intercom shows Hana's badge at 11:36 and 11:52.

suspects.name: Dario Wren
suspects.testimony: I was checking the west wing door at 11:40. It was still locked.
suspects.alibiProof: The door's card reader logged Dario at 11:39 and never opened.

suspects.name: Priya Nath
suspects.testimony: I was with a school group in the lobby from 11:30 to 12:00.
suspects.alibiProof: Twelve student sign-in slips list Priya as guide between 11:31 and 11:58.

suspects.name: Milo Ash
suspects.testimony: I was in the basement archive, cataloguing boxes during the drill.
suspects.contradiction: The archive light meter shows no movement after 11:20, and map glue was on Milo's cuffs.
